rationale: The entry thesis relied on resistance from the 5-minute 9-EMA, which has now caught down to $13.75 while price is reclaiming it at $13.76. Additionally, after breaking down to a session low of $13.63, the price failed to sustain downward momentum into the gap and is now curling higher on the 1-minute bars, giving back nearly half of the position's maximum favorable excursion. Closing now locks in a profit before a move above the 5-minute 9-EMA triggers a short squeeze back toward the entry price.
